metadata.title: Ten Years of Strategy: Yongqing with ex-CEIBS Fund Manager Luo Jiaming
metadata.guest_role: Former CEIBS Fund manager (~8.5 years); HKU physics

conclusion: Yongqing has Luo Jiaming after ~8.5 years at CEIBS Fund; he may raise a small Hong Kong book. Shenzhen kid, HKU physics, SiC thesis ~2006–08 that took ~20 years to show up in cars. He has run money since October 2015. A 2006 scalp given back in 2008 closed the PhD door. In 2016 Tencent climbed out while he was still in the pit. The tape is cheap quality, cyclicals at a supply gap, and going-out. Nvidia is the SiC clock; Moutai sits next to Tencent.
background: E205, Aug 29. Luo is a 实战派 listener. Shenzhen kid, HKU physics, KPMG then Nomura/HSBC and Galaxy International, CEIBS Fund from January 2018, left last month, maybe a small Hong Kong book. Yongqing wants the 2016 cheap-quality rewrite, cyclicals at a supply gap, and going-out — not a never-sell old-light rule. Whisper: 中欧/罗佳明 as 中国基金/罗家明; quotes below are the audible strings.
important_facts: Clock: 2006 HKU free-time bull — week-scale tens of thousands, 2008 gave it back, almost went to a US PhD. Physics as a job was two years on one SiC optical/electrical paper; the market felt wider. 2008 hiring freeze, KPMG audit, deal consulting, Nomura and HSBC research, Galaxy International AM, CEIBS Fund January 2018, ~8.5 years, left last month, maybe a small HK product. October 2015 is the start of the P&L he will own — more than ten years on the tape.

First rewrite 2016: he had bought cheap after 2015 and watched Tencent already out of the hole before the bear 'ended.' Buffett cheap-quality started to look operational, not a slogan. Cyclicals on this tape are a supply-gap trade — same as bilingual, fast young talent in a boom, or SiC taking twenty years to become a car part. Going-out is the other sleeve he and Yongqing flag for the next book. Do not hear 'value' as never-sell old light.

Tickers: Tencent is the 2016 climb-out print. Moutai is the old-light name he pairs with Tencent on the tape. Nvidia is SiC-plus-power showing up ~20 years after the thesis, not a 2006 trading account. A small HK product after a mainland fund is the career print — bilingual, physics, and a 2008 scar. Diligence whether the next book still buys cheap quality when it is already off the floor. Cyclicals on the later tape are a bottom-expand trade: buy the high-quality name when the cycle is empty, not every old-light ticker because it is cheap. Going-out is not one industry — brand-out, service-out, and China ecommerce-out all pay tuition. He will take that sleeve into a small Hong Kong product after 8.5 years at CEIBS. Moutai is the old-light name he actually pairs with Tencent; Nvidia is the SiC clock, not the 2006 scalp.

key_insights.view: 2008 is why he is not a physicist.
key_insights.question: What closed the PhD door?
key_insights.answer: A 2006 scalp given back. He wanted the mechanism, not two more years on one wafer paper.

key_insights.question: What did Tencent do?
key_insights.answer: It was already at highs while he was still waiting for the bear to 'end.' That is the Buffett lesson on the tape.

key_insights.question: Why mention the thesis?
key_insights.answer: Materials and cyclicals rhyme: demand shows up late. Nvidia is that clock, not a 2006 day-trade.
